criteria.name: Visual thesis
evidence: Ten pages sustain the urban-reuse system: dark cover, warm paper field, brick/blue/green operating accents, and infrastructure-to-public-realm thesis.

criteria.name: Composition
evidence: Timeline, elevated section, systems map, native comparison chart, collaboration field, operating loop, transfer matrix, and decision close are distinct architectures.

criteria.name: Material / domain fit
evidence: Facts are tied to Friends of the High Line materials; editorial analysis and transfer hypotheses are visibly labeled.

criteria.name: Readability
evidence: All 10 rendered pages were inspected at 1280x720; the initial 1.45 label-wrap defect was fixed and rechecked.

criteria.name: Editability
evidence: The deck is built from native text, rectangles, lines, arrows, and ovals; no page is a single rasterized image.

criteria.name: Reproducibility
evidence: New brief, build.py, PPTX, PDF/PNG renders, and inspection output are stored under examples/new_case_high_line.
This is a newly authored real-project case based on official Friends of the High Line materials, not an existing repository case rerun.
Primary visual review completed after one corrective iteration; second-reviewer sign-off remains pending.
revision_record: Initial build produced two visible defects: a wrapped 1.45 label and a malformed return arrow. Both were corrected and the full 10-page render was rechecked.
